# Opritek

> A diverse blog covering physics education, optics problems, art techniques, fashion, and interior design with curated resources and tutorials.

Opritek aggregates educational content and visual inspiration across multiple domains, with particular strength in Russian physics education materials and design aesthetics. The site serves as a reference hub for students, artists, and design enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- diffusing lens
- geometric optics
- thin lens
- image construction
- focal distance
- physics problems
- interior design
- bohemian furniture
- acrylic painting
- mobile legends
- transparent PNG
- lens formula
- optics exercises
- home decoration
- game graphics

## Physics & Optics Education

- [[29+] построите изображение предмета в рассеивающей линзе рис 101](https://opritek.blogspot.com/2021/02/29-101.html): Physics problem on diffusing lens image construction using geometric optics

## Art & Painting Techniques

- [[46+] Techniques De Peinture Acrylique - L'acrylique pouring..](https://opritek.blogspot.com/2025/04/46-techniques-de-peinture-acrylique.html): Tutorial on acrylic painting techniques including pouring and fluid art

## Interior Design & Home Decor

- [[53+] Fauteuil Suspendu Bohème Confortable Et Stylé](https://opritek.blogspot.com/2025/03/53-fauteuil-suspendu-boheme-confortable.html): Bohemian hanging chair and mid-century modern furniture design styles
- [[29+] Fauteuil Suspendu Bohème Confortable Stylé](https://opritek.blogspot.com/2025/03/29-fauteuil-suspendu-boheme-confortable.html): DIY bohemian hanging chair and home decoration ideas and styles
